title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature adds support for parsing JSON request bodies, allowing developers to easily handle complex data in their routes. It will provide a straightforward way to access request data, improving overall framework usability. By including this feature, yantraverse will be more competitive with other frameworks
testCases: Test error handling for invalid JSON
acceptance: The feature is considered complete when request bodies are correctly parsed and made available to route handlers, with clear error handling for invalid or unsupported request formats
reason: This feature is high-impact because it solves a real problem for developers using the framework, and is well-scoped to fit within the desired code quality and testing standards
